Waliphika iqiniso uTamudi ngokuphula kwabo umthetho.
Mhla lowo owonakele kubo bonke ebahlohla.
ISithunywa sika Allah [u Swalihi] sathi kubo: “Qaphelani, ikameli lika Allah namanzi alo!”.
Kepha abamukholwanga, baligenca balibulala; iNkosi yabo yababhubhisa bonke kwangasala muntu ngenxa yempambuko yabo.
